mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 79 degrees. Looking up tonight, we have a waning crescent moon and the ISS will be visible for four minutes starting at 9:06 PM, rising in the west southwest over Mount Horeb and heading toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot. Overnight, we will see a low of 58 degrees with no rain expected.

In city news, the Military Ridge State Trail is closed between Lincoln and South Franklin Street for bridge work through mid-November, with detours in place. Also, the Verona Police Department is hosting a free Citizen Academy starting September 23 to provide community members with an inside look at law enforcement operations.

Today is a busy day in Verona with events including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, and trivia nights at both The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing on Thursday, live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee on September 11, and the Dane County Farmer's Market on September 12.
Regarding local police activity, an investigation led to an arrest on Sunday, August 30, involving a staff member of the Verona Area School District accused of sexual assault of a child.
For dessert, Culver's is serving up Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough as the flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
